## Integration

- Shared contracts, frontend handoff and tracker updated where affected.
- Source/session/evidence identity, Stop cleanup and unavailable-data semantics preserved.
- No secrets, private pairing invitations, user recordings or generated model assets committed.

Physical-device, independent-accuracy and Wren results must be identified separately from browser fixtures.
